original_test_intent: Verify both DC-SCM rear USB2 connectors remain stable for 12 hours at 0C and +5% 5V/3.3V rails without data, reconnect, controller or platform errors.
original_method: Identify the DC-SCM module/revision and map rear slots 1 and 2 to tools, cables and hub/controller paths; preserve baseline evidence; maintain dry-chamber/dew-point control, cold-soak and apply measured +5% rails; run the approved dual-port SST profile for 12 hours with connector-specific integrity, enumeration, resets/retries and platform events; stop safely, warm above dew point and restore nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operator installs rear-port tools, controls dry chamber/high rails, supervises the run and performs safe warm-up/restoration.
required_inputs: DC-SCM module/revision and rear slot-to-hub/controller/tool map
Simultaneous-versus-sequential SST profile and data volume
Abort, warm-up, disconnect and restoration plan
safety_requirements: Prevent condensation through cooling and warm-up
Measure high rails independently and prevent overshoot
Abort on moisture risk, shared-controller instability, data mismatch or rail/thermal fault
Warm above dew point before chamber opening or connector handling
agent_execution_scope: Must not manipulate DC-SCM, chamber or rails and must not determine verdict
engineer_actions: Approve module topology, profile and limits
Review connector-specific evidence and determine verdict

command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: DC-SCM rear USB2 slots1-2, 0C, +5% 5V/3.3V and 12 hours are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate each rear connector's continuity and integrity with module-controller events and one chamber/rail timeline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds DC-SCM revision, dual-port topology, condensation/overshoot controls, abort and safe warm-up.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Front ports or a single rear connector cannot demonstrate both DC-SCM rear paths.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The rear connectors may share DC-SCM power or hub logic; automatic re-enumeration can conceal a common cold/high-rail reset.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row37 Wistron-Margin-00036-V002: approve DC-SCM revision and rear USB2 slots1-2 tool/cable/hub/controller map, simultaneous versus sequential SST profile/integrity volume, per-port retry/reset/reconnect limits, 0C humidity/dew-point/+5% rail tolerances, abort, safe warm-up and nominal restoration.

review_improvement: Separates DC-SCM rear coverage from front USB and requires connector-specific cold/high-rail continuity with safe chamber handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: The DC-SCM introduces a module-specific shared power and controller path. A common reset can cause both rear devices to re-enumerate while later SST output appears clean, so continuous module- and connector-correlated evidence is required.
